catalog.characterCountMethod: Unicode code points across isolated strings; excludes file names, separators, prompts, context sentences and retry generations.

readingValidation.method: Exact ID, characters and reading comparison for every active generated-catalog word, with all eight stored JMdict writing/reading/sense restriction verification flags required true.
readingValidation.scope: Reuses the existing local JMdict evidence snapshot; does not fetch a new dictionary or validate synthesized audio or Tokyo pitch accent.

ttsPolicy.default: Use the exact catalog kana reading as the isolated TTS text. Preserve katakana, small kana, small tsu, long-vowel marks and historical kana spellings. Select Japanese voice/language; do not translate, romanize, add punctuation, or speak the meaning.
ttsPolicy.qualityReview: Listen to every resulting clip against its reading. Flags prioritize pronunciation details rather than proving synthesis errors. Dictionary reading validation does not guarantee voice pronunciation, mora timing, pitch accent, or clean clip boundaries.
ttsPolicy.generationEstimate: One pass requires 565 separate word clips and 2257 input code points. Provider billing, prompts, minimum charges, batching separators and retries are not included.

flagDefinitions.kanji-reading-controlled: The displayed word contains kanji; supply its dictionary-verified kana reading so the voice does not choose an unintended reading.
flagDefinitions.context-sensitive-kanji: Editorial priority check for written forms whose lexical interpretation or readings can vary. The exact selected reading is verified locally; the snapshot is not an inventory of every alternative reading.
flagDefinitions.katakana-japanese-pronunciation: Preserve Japanese katakana pronunciation instead of pronouncing the source-language word; do not strip long vowels or small kana.
flagDefinitions.extended-katakana-sound: The reading contains small vowel kana or ヴ; check the combined loanword sound rather than spelling the kana separately.
flagDefinitions.small-tsu: Check the mora of consonant closure for っ/ッ; word-final interjections need an abrupt closure, not an added tsu syllable.
flagDefinitions.long-vowel-spelling: Heuristic spelling cue for a long vowel or vowel sequence. Preserve the catalog length and natural Japanese realization; not a pitch-accent annotation.
flagDefinitions.kanji-numeral-component: A lexical word contains a kanji numeral component. Use its whole verified reading; do not ask TTS to expand the characters as an arbitrary number.
flagDefinitions.historical-kana-spelling: Preserve catalog づ/ぢ orthography and verify its natural modern Japanese realization; do not narrate the kana name.
flagDefinitions.shared-kana-reading: Another word has the same reading after kana-script normalization. Keep word-specific filenames and independently verify lexical accent.
flagDefinitions.interjection-intonation: Short conversational reaction: use appropriate standalone Japanese intonation without inventing a surrounding phrase.
flagDefinitions.very-short-clip: At most two reading code points: inspect for missing onset, unwanted added words, long padding, or a completely silent output.
flagDefinitions.particle-parsing-risk: The kana string may be misparsed as a grammatical particle; confirm the lexical pronunciation in the note.
flagDefinitions.orthographic-input-override: Use the natural written word instead of its bare reading to avoid the identified lexical/particle ambiguity; the required spoken target remains the reading field.
